rule: An obligation closes when a verifier re-reads the item on main and records verdict `implemented`. Builders do not edit verdicts.

obligations.feature: Create a workspace directly inside a sidebar section
obligations.gap: No user sections; the single My workspaces group's menu only offers Add project.
obligations.done_when: a user can reach the feature in the app and it behaves as the cited evidence describes

obligations.feature: Assign a per-workspace number on creation
obligations.gap: The schema has a number column but no create path, persistence function or UI assigns or shows one.

obligations.feature: Initializing state with progress while the workspace is created
obligations.gap: The dialog steps through creating, detecting-setup and running-setup (createFlow.ts reduceProgress) and create_workspace writes an initializing row, but the sidebar gets the workspace only after the worktree exists: no initializing row or view, no initialization log.
obligations.done_when: the gap in `why` is closed and the feature matches the cited evidence end to end
